name: elements-workspace
description: ElementsPanel workspace — a fork of the MCSManager project

scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix common && npm run type-check --prefix panel && npm run type-check --prefix daemon && npm run type-check --prefix frontend
scripts.install: npm run install-dependents && npm run preview-build
scripts.install-dependents: cd daemon && npm install && cd ../panel && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.all: concurrently -n Daemon,Frontend,Panel -c cyan,magenta,green -p name "npm run dev --prefix daemon" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix panel"
scripts.preview-build: cd common && npm install && npm run build
